login.subtitle: Sign in to your Music Seerr server
login.errorUnreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and that this iPhone is on the same network.
login.errorServerTooOld: This server is too old for the app. Update Music Seerr on the server.

home.empty: Play something and it will show up here.

library.guestBody: Sign in with a Jellyfin account to browse the library. As a guest you can search and request songs.

detail.notInLibraryHint: None of these songs are in your library yet. Tap one for a preview.
detail.ownedOf: {{owned}} of {{total}} songs are in your library.

search.hint: Search the catalog and request songs for your library.

offline.title: Downloads
offline.empty: Downloaded songs play without the server. Use the download button on an album, playlist, or song.
offline.downloadsOnly: Offline mode: only the songs downloaded on this iPhone.

settings.removeAllConfirm: Remove every downloaded song from this iPhone?
settings.offlineBanner: Server unreachable. Downloaded songs still play.
settings.preferencesFooter: Saved to your account: the web app uses the same settings.
settings.serverFooter: The address this iPhone uses to reach Music Seerr. Change it to switch between your home network, a VPN, or a domain.
settings.serverChangeBody: Another address of the same Music Seerr server. You stay signed in.
settings.serverOtherBody: Your account is not signed in on that server. Sign in there?
settings.jellyfinFooter: Server settings for everyone, the same as in the web app. Changes apply after Save.
settings.musicDirOk: The music folder exists on the server.
settings.musicDirMissing: The music folder does not exist on the server.
settings.urlInvalid: Start the address with http:// or https://
settings.aliasesFooter: A former or alternate artist name (as Deezer shows it) mapped to the name in your library. Tap an alias to remove it.
settings.aliasFromBody: The name as Deezer shows it.
settings.storageFooter: Songs downloaded to this iPhone, in the Files app under On My iPhone.

errors.alias_same_name: An alias cannot be the same as the library name.

errors.offlineBody: The Music Seerr server is unreachable. Your downloaded songs are in the Downloads tab.
